voiceover_script:
The city went under. We kept walking.
Bioluminescent plating. Cold light, no source.
Armour that breathes in the dark.
Flooded streets. Zero panic.
Silence is the loudest thing down here.
This is Deep Current.
Built for water that doesn't drain.
Glow where there's nothing left to see by.
Live now. Link in bio.
